title: A Conversation about Purpose with Every Student

decisionLog.forum: Delivery lead proposition and mobilisation sense-check
decisionLog.outcome: Proceed to delivery design on a deliberately phased basis: discover effective human developmental practice first, build capability with willing trailblazer partners, test portability, then institutionalise what proves valuable.
decisionLog.notes: King's Canvas remains the living student-facing expression of the proposition rather than the proposition itself. Digital design should follow and extend proven developmental practice rather than determine it.
